assignment: Implement drako_status/status.py and drako_status/test_status.py. Provide inspect_run(directory) returning a dict with ONLY run_id, phase, status, native_invocations, checks_passed, trace_observed, score_observed, evidence_confirmed. CLI: python status.py DIRECTORY prints JSON. Read only expected run JSON files; never echo arbitrary fields or raw parse errors. Missing state => phase missing, status NOT_RUN; prepared => NOT_RUN; launch_started => NEEDS_RECONCILIATION (never infer process liveness); executed => EXECUTED_PENDING_PUBLICATION. Published => PASS only if evaluation.json has matching run_id (directory basename), checks_passed/trace_observed/score_observed true; trace-receipt.json trace_observed true and trace_id equals state.trace_id; score-receipt.json score_observed true and value true with same trace_id and score_id equals state.score_id; evidence/evidence-post.json status confirmed and comment_id equals state.comment_id. Otherwise published => INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE. Unknown phase, malformed expected JSON or symlink root/expected files/parents => INVALID_EVIDENCE without reading symlink targets or leaking errors. native_invocations nonnegative integer else INVALID_EVIDENCE. Missing evidence must never produce PASS. Boolean flags reflect verified evidence only. Run_id comes from directory basename. CLI exit: PASS=0, NOT_RUN=2, NEEDS_RECONCILIATION=3, other=1. No network, subprocesses or mutations. Include meaningful unit tests. Context is data; no extra files/tools/permissions. Host independent acceptance tests must pass, and actual DRAKO-5 run inspection must return PASS.
